name: API - Nearshore Small Balance Open Card

1.content:
Small Balance Cards are those with remaining balances of $10 or less. You will identify the source of those funds, and ensure all funds are reabsorbed by Corpay, refunded to the Client, or reissued to the Vendor as appropriate.

Open the Nearshore Small Balance Followup Sheet and locate the section labeled with your name. Each row in the spreadsheet contains the information about one card that has an open balance. You should work cards in order, based on the following criteria:

  • Work all cards that do NOT have the word "Fee" in the Fee column, from oldest to newest.*
  • Work cases that have the word "Fee" in the Fee column, from oldest to newest.

*Small balance cards labeled "fee" are much more likely to have a remaining balance from a fee that Corpay paid, rather than leftover funding from the customer. We want to prioritize getting our customer's money back to them first!

Locate the next card to be worked based on the criteria above, and copy the Payment ID for that card.

25.content:
Open the Card Details page in Galileo, and navigate to the All Transactions section. Review all transactions listed in this section, comparing them to what you see in Bizpay's Settlement History.

Read More: Researching a Card in Galileo▼

  1. Log in to Galileo. On the dashboard that populates, click CST to open the Galileo Customer Service Tool.
  2. Under the Account tab, select External Account ID from the drop-down. Then, paste the Payment ID (from either the Follow Up Spreadsheet or Bizpay) into the field and click Search.
  3. Click on either one of the linked numbers in the Card Number/PRN column to open the Card Details.
  4. Expand the Account Info section and select All Transactions.
  5. If needed, adjust the Start Date to view all transactions processed on the card, and click Submit to update the results. The default display shows transactions processed in the last 30 days; it is recommended to use the transaction date associated with the Funding transaction in Bizpay as the Start Date.

48.node_name: Tree memory: purpose, node map, data dictionary
48.content:
# claude.md - API - Nearshore Small Balance Open Card - org 604910

Purpose: Small Balance card workflow for Corpay PMG (BizPay) Payment Processors, driven by the BizPay API. The agent enters a Payment ID; the tree reads the payment, routes it, and stops only at checks the API cannot answer. The Cancel Card is submitted by API.

Node map
1 Start: payment_id -> 42
42 Get BizPay payment (Data, CO 1299 bizpay__get_payment_by_id) -> 43
43 Stage BizPay payment (Script) -> 44
44 Route on entry_route: not_found -> 2 (re-enter ID -> 1) | verify_balance -> 29 | else (no remainder) -> 6
29 Verify balance vs Followup sheet (manual): match -> 3 | no -> 30
6, 24, 25, 26, 27, 23 Zero-balance research in Galileo/Comdata (manual) -> positive balance -> 34 (agent enters balance) -> 3
3 Route the remaining balance (Script) -> 45
45 Route on resolution_route: approved_request -> 28 (BizPay approved date shown; agent compares with sheet date) | request_pending -> 20 | ipay_rpps_check -> 31 (manual) | client_notes_check -> 41 (manual) | else -> 4
31, 41 -> 4
4 Build the Cancel Card request (Script) -> 5
5 Review and submit Cancel Card (agent confirms prefilled fields) -> 49
49 Route: cancel_submitted == true -> 18 (no second POST after Back) | else -> 35
35 Post Cancel Card (Data, CO 1300 bizpay__post_payment_action) -> 36
36 Grade the Cancel Card (Script) -> 46
46 Route: cancel_submitted == true -> 18 (disposition) -> 19 | else -> 47 (edit and resend -> 5, or done in BizPay -> 18)
Escalations: 21, 22, 23, 27, 30. No action: 20.

Data dictionary (form data)
payment_id - node 1; merged into both CO URLs
client_exception (ipay | civitas | other), remaining_balance, funding, manual_load_value, fee_amount, cancel_card_request_exists, cancel_card_request_approved, cancel_card_request_approved_date (shown on 28, empty when null), card_status_date (shown on 6) - node 43, from the GET
entry_route - node 43; resolution_route - node 3
rpps_available - node 31; client_restricts_partial - node 41
resolution, cancel_card_reason, amount, fee, payment_note - node 4, editable on node 5; read by the CO 1300 body template
agent_email - node 4 sets system@zingtree.com (BizPay system user from Mayur, 10/22), editable on node 5; read by CO 1300
cancel_submitted - node 36; read by 46 and 49
transforms.payment_html, approved_date_html (43), cancel_summary_html (4), post_result_html (36)

External systems
Data source "BizPay Dev (Paymerang)", OAuth2 client credentials. Dev base https://develop.api.pega.dev.paymerang.com/
CO 1300 body: {"action":"cancel_card","resolution":"${resolution}","cancel_card_reason":"${cancel_card_reason}","amount":${amount},"fee":${fee},"payment_note":"${payment_note}","agent_email":"${agent_email}"} with header Content-Type: application/json

Gotchas
Amounts are compared in cents (floats).
Civitas client ids 4016 and 12113 are PROD ids (Jonathan 10/27); dev also matches on client name.
No Date in scripts: node 1 runs the Timestamp webhook (app 381) to set today (m/d/y, America/Chicago). Notes end with the Agent Portal login before @ (agent), else agent_name; outside the Agent Portal they fall back to MM/DD/YY and [AGENT NAME].
A double quote in payment_note breaks the POST body.
Routing follows Helena's Small Balance ZT Workflow Visio (10/20). Partial reissue check sends partial_reissue (added by Mayur 10/22), fee blank per Visio. Negative balance goes to Escalate: Negative Balance (27), confirmed by Jonathan 10/22 over the Visio's Manual Cancellation. fee for cancel_fee paths follows the tree (remaining balance) and BizPay may reject it if it expects service_fee.

Node 28 stays an agent choice: the Sheet Created Date lives only in the Followup spreadsheet, so the API date is shown but not compared.

Changelog
- API build from the 10/20 copy of tree 726245811: GET-driven routing, manual checks kept, single prefilled Cancel Card POST.
- Reconciled with the 10/20 working session: spreadsheet checks and Galileo/Comdata research stay manual; approval date and system user pending from BizPay.
- 10/22: partial_reissue resolution, cancel_card_request_approved_date shown on 28, agent_email defaults to system@zingtree.com.
- 10/23: payment notes show amounts to 2 decimals; payment table on 29 restyled (padding, row lines, remaining balance highlighted) per Carrie 10/26.
- 10/27 (Jonathan/SME): reissue check, RPPS and full refund send fee = service fee + manual value load and the note shows the payment amount; Civitas also on client 12113; notes auto-fill today's date and the agent; those three default the cancel reason to Unable to reach vendor (expired backlog cleared, Jonathan 10/27); node 28 points to Activity History only when BizPay returns no date.
- 10/23: node 49 blocks a duplicate Cancel Card POST when the agent goes Back to 5 after BizPay accepted one (Jonathan's dev test, 36703751).
- Aligned to Helena's Visio: iPay RPPS also when funding + manual load = remaining; partial check fee blank; card status date shown on the card-age check.
